svg.text: Style tile v0.1 · Phase 2 · tokens in tokens.mjs
GDD 10.2 palette (first 7) + v0.1 additions. Red is not used anywhere, so it can never read as "wrong".
Text contrast (charcoal text unless noted) · target ≥ 4.5:1
Hoeveel stenen moeten er nog bij?
Instruction line · 36 / ExtraBold 800 · one line, max ~8 words
Numerals · check in Figma with Nunito
Pass: 1 has a flag + is narrower than 7; 6/9 open tails differ at 32 px; 4 is open.
Primary = yellow, positive confirm = green, secondary = white. Never text-only, never icon-only.
Retry: tiles shake gently, no colour change, no sound. A wrong pick never turns red.
